structuredContent.name: tenants.get-user-tenants
structuredContent.description: List the tenants one user is a member of, ordered by tenant identifier, with each tenant's name, status and the user's role. Callers always see their own memberships, a global administrator sees any user's, and a TenantOwner sees another user's memberships only in tenants the caller owns. Memberships the caller may not see are left out, so the list can be empty. Results are paged: pageSize takes 1 to 100 (default 20, larger values are reduced to 100); to read the next page, pass the returned next-page cursor as the cursor argument: it is the result document's cursor, also reported as paging.nextCursor when a paging argument was sent. offset is not supported.

UserId.description: Identifier of the user whose memberships are listed: the subject (sub) claim the identity provider issues for that user. Always set it, including for your own memberships: an omitted UserId does not default to you and usually returns an empty list. To list your own tenants without knowing your subject, use tenants.list-tenants; it returns no roles, and a global administrator gets every tenant there.

Cursor.description: Has no effect: use the pageSize and cursor call arguments instead.

PageSize.description: Has no effect: use the pageSize and cursor call arguments instead.
